import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,glob,hashlib,subprocess,sys,json.decoder as jd
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r530/'
C='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus/'
r=json.load(open(L+'reservation.json',encoding='utf-8'))
ids=set(r['ids'])
print('reservation row keys:',list(r['rows'][0].keys()))
files=sorted(glob.glob(C+'mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl'))
print('nchunks',len(files))
def h(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
dec=json.JSONDecoder()
def tokens(s):
    # top-level key->raw value token map
    i=s.index('{')+1; out={}
    while True:
        while s[i] in ' \t\r\n,': i+=1
        if s[i]=='}': break
        assert s[i]=='"'
        k,e=jd.scanstring(s,i+1)
        i=e
        while s[i] in ' \t\r\n:': i+=1
        v,e2=dec.raw_decode(s,i)
        out[k]=(i,e2)
        i=e2
    return out
found={}
keysshown=False
for f in files:
    bs=open(f,'rb').read()
    fh=h(bs)
    start=0; ln=0
    while start<len(bs):
        nl=bs.find(b'\n',start)
        if nl<0: raw=bs[start:]; has=False; nxt=len(bs)
        else: raw=bs[start:nl]; has=True; nxt=nl+1
        ln+=1
        # quick filter
        hit=None
        for i in ids:
            if (b'"mathdb_id":%d'%i in raw) or (b'"mathdb_id": %d'%i in raw) or (b'"id":%d'%i in raw) or (b'"id": %d'%i in raw) or (b'/p/%d/'%i in raw):
                hit=True;break
        if hit:
            txt=raw.decode('utf-8')
            o=json.loads(txt)
            if not keysshown:
                print('corpus keys:',list(o.keys())); keysshown=True
            mid=o.get('mathdb_id',o.get('id'))
            if mid in ids:
                found.setdefault(mid,[]).append(dict(chunk=f,chunk_sha256=fh,line=ln,newline=has,raw=txt,raw_sha256=h(raw)))
        start=nxt
print('found',{k:len(v) for k,v in found.items()})
print('missing',sorted(ids-set(found)))
out={}
for mid in r['ids']:
    assert len(found[mid])==1,(mid,len(found[mid]))
    x=found[mid][0]; t=x['raw']; tk=tokens(t); o=json.loads(t)
    field=[k for k in ('statement','statement_md','problem_statement','body') if k in o][0]
    a,b=tk[field]; rawtok=t[a:b]
    stmt=o[field]
    out[str(mid)]=dict(chunk=x['chunk'],chunk_sha256=x['chunk_sha256'],line=x['line'],newline=x['newline'],raw_line_sha256=x['raw_sha256'],raw_line=x['raw'],statement_field=field,raw_statement_token_sha256=h(rawtok.encode('utf-8')),decoded_statement_sha256=h(stmt.encode('utf-8')),decoded_statement=stmt)
txt=json.dumps(out,indent=1,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'write_lane.py','literal-bindings.json'],input=txt,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('write',p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
print('total len',len(txt))
